identity.title: Autonomous Hermes Opportunity-to-Intent Decision Cycle — Vertical Slice
identity.objective: Compose a bounded, foreground, credential-free one-cycle autonomous Hermes opportunity choice into native ExecutionIntent, EXEC-FEAS and exploratory Gate C using canonical Alpha and STRAT-LIFE inputs; emit source-labelled NO_TRADE/rejected/eligible-preview receipts for future learning. No real provider/model invocation, gateway order, account or capital authority. DATA-03 and formal OOS not prerequisites.
